name: Best and Worst Cleaners for Hardwood Floors
title-tag: Best and Worst Cleaners for Hardwood Floors: A Pro Guide
meta-description: A refinishing contractor grades hardwood floor cleaners: what to use, what quietly ruins finish, and why polish products can double your refinishing bill.
post-summary: November 23, 2026 · The best hardwood cleaner is a pH-neutral spray on a barely-damp microfiber pad; the worst are steam mops, vinegar, oil soaps, and anything promising shine. A product-by-product grading with the chemistry behind each verdict — and why the wrong bottle can turn a $1.99/sq ft recoat into a $3.99 full sand.
